{{Top}}
'''Pta fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] which was easily squashed.

==History==
[[Jemba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] threatened to crush the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] 'like a pta fruit' if the [[Human/Legends|Human]] sided with his rival, [[Clat'Ha]] during the [[mission to Bandomeer]].
